hard_fail_rules.name: Warranty Expiry Hard Fail
hard_fail_rules.description: Claim submission date is beyond warranty duration plus grace period.

hard_fail_rules.name: Excluded Liquid / Physical Damage
hard_fail_rules.description: Reported fault falls under excluded physical or liquid damage categories.

hard_fail_rules.name: Unauthorized Service Center Attempt
hard_fail_rules.description: Previous repair conducted by unauthorized third party.

warning_rules.name: Reporting Period Exceeded
warning_rules.description: Fault reported more than 30 days after occurrence.

warning_rules.name: Serial Number Optical Mismatch
warning_rules.description: Serial number on receipt slightly differs from user input or photo.

manual_review_rules.name: Missing Secondary Evidence
manual_review_rules.description: Missing serial number photograph or diagnostic report.

manual_review_rules.name: Multiple Previous Repairs
manual_review_rules.description: More than 2 previous repair claims logged for the same product ID.
